# proxmox_qemu_monitor (Resource)

Runs a QEMU monitor command through `POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/monitor`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_qemu_monitor" "m" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  vmid     = 300
  command  = "info status"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `result` (String)
